caption: The drawing depicts a detailed rendering of a lantern. The lantern is composed of a rectangular, box-like body with metallic, gold, and brass tones, featuring a glass panel on its front face through which the internal components are visible. Inside the lantern, there appears to be a central cylindrical holder, likely for a candle or lamp wick, surrounded by a circular base and a smaller round object to its right. The top section of the lantern is cylindrical with a domed cap, vent holes around the upper part, and a latch mechanism. The lantern has a thin, curved carrying handle attached to the side, rendered in a dark steel or iron color. The drawing is set against a plain, light beige background, with no other objects present, and features a handwritten signature in the lower right corner. The use of muted colors, including browns, greens, and golds, gives the drawing a realistic and precise depiction of the lantern's materials and structure.
